title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Sunburn
intro: Herbal essential oils for sunburn are natural extracts obtained from plants and flowers, used to soothe and calm the skin after excessive exposure to the sun. These oils have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cooling properties, which make them highly effective in treating sunburn. Some of the most commonly used herbal essential oils for sunburn relief include aloe vera oil, lavender oil, chamomile oil, peppermint oil, tea tree oil, eucalyptus oil, and frankincense oil. These oils help to reduce redness, itching, and swelling, while also promoting skin healing and hydration, making them a popular alternative to traditional sunburn treatments.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis essential oils are widely used to treat sunburn due to their anti-inflammatory, soothing, and moisturizing properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat sunburn by reducing redness, swelling, and pain, while also promoting skin hydration and healing. The bioactive constituents of aloe barbadensis, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, work together to provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which aid in the healing process. The benefits of using aloe barbadensis essential oils to treat sunburn include rapid relief from discomfort, reduced risk of blistering and scarring, and improved skin texture and tone.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Brazilian journal of biology = Revista brasleira de biologia", Aloe barbadensis essential oils for sunburn are effective in accelerating wound healing, promoting cell proliferation and migration, and exhibiting antioxidant properties, which help in reducing oxidative stress and promoting faster healing of sunburns.

preparations.preparation_study: According to the study on "Anti-cancer agents in medicinal chemistry", Calendula officinalis essential oils may provide protective effects against acute radiation dermatitis, including skin irritation and inflammation, which are also similar symptoms experienced in sunburn.
